sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 480 x 388 x 88 mm (w x d x h) (axis order assumed); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Yamaha PX10 manual page 9 and the specification page (read by a research pass 2026-11-12): per channel an XLR-3-31 and a balanced 1/4 in TRS input in parallel, Neutrik NL4MD speakON, binding post and phone-jack outputs, an AC IN with a plug clamp (inlet not named), no network or control ports. The size has an assumed axis order, so beta-modelled; the ports are the Bêta proposal ports (11 of 11 listed, no mains port). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
